readme.note: Right-side badge + response chain demo. A generates a random number each tick and sends it to B; A shows whatever B responds with in its own right-side badge. B receives A's number, appends a random letter, and forwards the combined value to C; B also acknowledges A's number with a response, and shows whatever C responds with in its own right-side badge. C receives B's value, shows it in its right-side badge, and responds to B with a random number. Turn on both 'Show Simulation Values' and 'Show Script Badge' on this view (already on by default here) to see the normal left badge (last value sent) alongside the script-controlled right badge (last thing received back) on every node. Step Simulation a few times to watch values and responses ripple through.

parts.label: A - Generator
parts.description: Generates a new random number each tick and sends it to B. Shows whatever B responds with in the right-side badge (blue).

parts.label: B - Processor
parts.description: Receives A's number, appends a random letter, and forwards the combined value to C. Acknowledges A with a response. Shows whatever C responds with in the right-side badge (purple).

parts.label: C - Receiver
parts.description: Receives B's combined value, shows it in the right-side badge (green), and responds to B with a random number.
